paper_id: Yang et al. - 2010 - Beyond Trilateration On the Localizability of Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
title: Beyond Trilateration: On the Localizability of Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
motivation: Trilateration wrongly recognizes localizable graphs as nonlocalizable
problem_framing: Test localizability by identifying wheel graphs in one-hop neighborhoods
key_insight: Trilateration is a special case (minimum wheel graph with four vertices) of wheel graphs
method_signature: WHEEL: find wheel vertices by block calculation in N[v]
evaluation_criteria: Recognition rate of localizable nodes vs trilateration baseline
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Lack theoretical analyses of gap between WHEEL and trilateration
evidence_for_taste: This is a direction of our future studies
thinking_moves: 把trilateration退化成wheel graph的特例来理解
从图论 rigidity 性质推导出局部化的充分条件
先证明必要条件(Lemma 4)再给出充要条件(Theorem 1)
用prototype+simulation双重验证工程可行性
cites_own_work: OceanSense project (prior work on sea depth measurement)
